definition.def: The diversity of something is the fact that it contains many very different elements.
examples: ...to introduce more choice and diversity into the education system.

definition.def: Diversity involves the deliberate inclusion in a group or activity of people who are, for example, of different races, genders, and religions.
examples: The council was set up in 2008 to promote diversity and inclusion in workplaces and communities.

definition.def: A diversity of things is a range of things which are very different from each other.
examples: His object is to gather as great a diversity of material as possible. [+ of]
